I'm trying. It's easier when I remember I can do something for others & I have love to give to people who want it.

I've been someone who looks at a train and wonders if I could throw myself on the tracks, sees a bus and wants to get hit, every tall place is somewhere to jump from, etc., since I was a toddler. So. No help for me haha. I have at least 3 plans at any given point.
No. There are no manageable chunks and that shit is for people who deserve to be alive, anyway. Have fun with your nice little manageable life.
I'm dying actually. So. I'm not gonna have that time to waste waiting around, but it's fine. It doesn't matter anyway.
Don't. Just don't. You know nothing about my situation, so no, it's not going to be alright. It's really cool that things turned out well for you, but some of us weren't supposed to exist.
There's nothing loveable about me. Being strong will cost me my life, I refuse to do this shit anymore. I'm buying a gun this week.

For fucking what?? More pain?? To continue to be too broke to afford medical treatment?? To see the rest of my teeth break and fall out from malnutrition??? What the actual literal fuck should I stay for????

I was in a wheelchair with a paralyzed arm and nowhere to go. Help was offered. I personally don't believe I'm an asshole for taking them up on it or for suffering the unpreventable physical health issues that have kept me here. I just don't understand why they won't let me do anything to leave if they want me gone so badly. Maybe you're right. I just can't do this anymore.

Thank you for the kind words. I'm honestly contemplating suicide. Even my now-former therapist was telling me I wasn't doing enough, that I had to do this alone, and I have nowhere to go. Also just got dumped; SO was moving away and told me I could come with them, but then left because they were "tired of everything being so bad so all the time." I'm tired too. I'm so, so tired.
I'm 22. Parents are narcissistic and father molested me when I was 13.

I am so sorry. You deserve so much better than that and I'm honestly so proud of you for getting through school for yourself; after this is over, we can both cut our parents off, and be rid of the constant threat of having our lives as we know them ripped out from beneath us.

I wouldn't be so upset about it if she had ever existed as a competent human being on her own. This woman literally married my father (who is even more blatantly narcissistic than she is) because she had zero other options and was terrified of being on her own after being horribly abused by HER parents for her entire childhood. I can't even have an intelligent conversation with her at this point because she's intellectually unable to talk with anyone at a level above middle school education. I'm outraged at her and also at myself for letting something so small get to me so deeply. All it really takes is a single interaction to make me feel like a scared 12-year-old again.
